name: chevron-up
description: A solid rounded triangular arrowhead for directional navigation.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The fill-only contour is the exact union of the Regular 1.70 stroke exterior, with radius-.85 free-end caps. Straight edges, internal intersections and any rounded outer joint are constructed analytically from the Outline centerline. Line marks have no enclosed body or counter to fill; both styles intentionally retain the same recognizable mark at Regular. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Owner rejected the radius-1.50 curved-head experiment on2026-10-27. Return to the original straight-arm V head with round .85 caps and round stroke joins at Regular1.70. Do not reintroduce a broad centerline fillet. Owner requested a solid arrowhead for every Filled arrow on2026-10-27. Outline retains the open straight-arm V. Filled closes that same head into a solid triangular body, including the Regular1.70 round exterior at its three corners; shaft and tray geometry are retained. Corresponding tip, arm endpoints, native outer bounds and Regular1.70 weight remain aligned. This is a semantic solid-head exception to reproducing the open Outline interior. Owner approved this current pair on2026-10-27.

review.note: Owner approved both current styles: open straight-arm V head in Outline and solid triangular head in Filled, with aligned tips/endpoints, original shafts/trays and Regular1.70 reference.
